cards.card_text: They also ask, "Is Saul also among the prophets?" A man who lives there replies, "And who is their father?" and that line becomes a proverb.
cards.verse_text: Is Saul also among the prophets?” Then a man who lived there replied, “And who is their father?” So the saying became a proverb: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
cards.snippet: …there replied, “And who is their father?” So the saying became a proverb: “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

cards.card_text: "May the LORD judge between you and me, and may the LORD take vengeance on you, but my hand will never be against you." He backs it up with an old proverb: "Wickedness proceeds from the wicked."
cards.verse_text: As the old proverb says, ‘Wickedness proceeds from the wicked.’ But my hand will never be against you.

cards.card_text: A new section of Proverbs opens with a heading: "The proverbs of Solomon:" That's Solomon, son of David, king of Israel (Proverbs 1:1), and his sayings come two lines at a time, often setting two kinds of people side by side.
cards.verse_text: The proverbs of Solomon: A wise son brings joy to his father, but a foolish son grief to his mother.

cards.card_text: And this man put in the WORK: he pondered, searched out and arranged many proverbs.
cards.verse_text: Not only was the Teacher wise, but he also taught the people knowledge; he pondered, searched out, and arranged many proverbs.
cards.snippet: …also taught the people knowledge; he pondered, searched out, and arranged many proverbs.

cards.card_text: Again the word of the LORD comes, this time about a proverb people have in the land of Israel: 'The days go by, and every vision fails.'
cards.verse_text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, what is this proverb that you have in the land of Israel: ‘The days go by, and every vision fails’?

cards.card_text: God says He will put an end to Israel's proverb about failing visions.
cards.verse_text: Therefore tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘I will put an end to this proverb, and in Israel they will no longer recite it.’ But say to them: ‘The days are at hand when every vision will be fulfilled.

cards.card_text: In its place, God gives them a new line: 'The days are at hand when every vision will be fulfilled.' That old proverb treated the visions like a COMING SOON sign you drive past so often you stop seeing it.

cards.verse_text: I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a proverb; I will cut him off from among My people.
cards.snippet: …My face against that man and make him a sign and a proverb; I will cut him off from among My people.

cards.card_text: Now He says all who speak in proverbs will quote one about her: 'Like mother, like daughter.'
cards.verse_text: Behold, all who speak in proverbs will quote this proverb about you: ‘Like mother, like daughter.’
cards.snippet: Behold, all who speak in proverbs will quote this proverb about you: ‘Like mother, like daughter.’

cards.card_text: True or false: God says the people of Israel will keep on quoting the sour grapes proverb.
cards.verse_text: As surely as I live, declares the Lord GOD, you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.
cards.snippet: …I live, declares the Lord GOD, you will no longer quote this proverb in Israel.
